observations: Photo 0 shows the front of a retail box for a MAXMECH cordless drill.
The model number CD 24-10B is clearly printed on the box.
The box specifies a 20V MAX Li-ion battery and a 10mm clamping diameter.
A 'SON' (Standards Organisation of Nigeria) logo is visible on the bottom right of the box.
The actual drill, battery, and charger are not visible outside of the packaging.
The background suggests a retail or warehouse environment.

risks.risk: The box may be empty or missing the battery and charger.
risks.proof: Photo of the open carrying case showing the drill, battery, and charger.

risks.risk: The drill may be non-functional or have internal damage.
risks.proof: Video of the drill being tested and rotating.

risks.risk: The battery may be degraded and unable to hold a charge.
risks.proof: Video of the drill running under load or battery level indicator.

proof_requests: Photo of the open box showing the drill and all included accessories.
Video of the drill operating to confirm functionality.
response.reason: Only the retail packaging is shown. The actual drill and its essential accessories (battery and charger) must be seen to verify their existence and condition before a valuation can be made.
